summary: {clerk} calls for the standby procedure when a display fails even though the votes may still be reaching the system.
realLife: Anderson said his office would set aside the electronic equipment over a display fault and use an oral call until the system could be trusted.
inGame: needs: the display status and the standby procedure.

turns.pulledBy: The panel passes its check before voting starts.
turns.what: Staff clear the equipment for use.

turns.writesBack: The tally rests on the clerks' recorded answers.
